purpose: Turnkey generation spec to upgrade/replace BibleQuest pixel assets to the reference-sheet style and wire them into the pixel-asset registry.
blockedOn: PixelLab connector must carry Authorization: Bearer <token>. Currently returns 401 in-session; api.pixellab.ai is also blocked from the sandbox.

conventions.pngRule: PNG pixel size MUST be an integer multiple of the registry logical grid (cols x mult, rows x mult). Normalize every PixelLab output to exact pngPx (trim transparent, snap-scale).
conventions.stylePrompt: 32-bit inspired pixel art icon, single subject, centered, transparent background. 1-2px dark charcoal/evergreen outline, 2-3 flat shade levels per material, minimal dithering, highlight from upper-left, soft pixel shadow to lower-right, warm calm sacred storybook tone. Palette: parchment #F6E9D1, evergreen #1F5E3A, moss #6B8F4E, gold #DAAF37, leather brown #8B5E34, charcoal #2C2C2C, prayer-blue #295470.
conventions.generateThenNormalize: Generate at genCanvasPx for model quality, then downscale/pad to exact pngPx with nearest-neighbor and re-quantize to palette.
conventions.lighting: upper-left highlight, lower-right shadow, 2-3 shade levels, minimal dither
conventions.smallSpriteRule: small mark sprites are flat (no outline); feature sprites + mascots carry a 1-cell twilight #1e3329 outline
